scripts.//prebuild: The site links the library through `file:..`, and bun does not run a file: dependency's own prepare script, so nothing else creates the dist/ the exports map points at. A clean checkout (CI, a Pages build) therefore fails to resolve @luzir/bolota until the library is built, which is what this does. Bun runs pre<script> automatically before `build`. The install here is deliberately not --frozen-lockfile: the deploy host runs an older bun than this repo's CI, and its job is only to make the library buildable. CI enforces the lockfile on its own.
scripts.prebuild: cd .. && bun install && bun run build
